source_title: Sainz angry about missed opportunity following Verstappen clash
evidence_summary: Contact produced a front-right puncture and a slow return to the pits; a later gearbox issue caused the retirement.

source_title: Bottas reflects on early lap collisions in Japan
evidence_summary: Bottas attributed suspension and sidepod damage, an undriveable car, and retirement to the Sargeant collision.
Williams reported that Sargeant retired following the contact with Bottas.

source_title: Sainz hit with five-second time penalty after collision with Piastri
evidence_summary: Formula 1 explicitly linked the Sainz contact to Piastri front-wing damage, a forced stop, and a drop down the order.
